# Study Time Statistics 2.1.0

## English

2.1 adds detailed reading trajectories: optional start/end position, current position, and manual characters read. Leaving characters blank produces a clearly labeled estimate. New analytics include total and unique-estimated characters, repeated reading, equivalent full passes, time per 1,000 characters, notes reaching the end, and per-entry measurement provenance.

The default dashboard home is named Study Overview, and compact chart labels use readable month/day dates below the axis.

Positions and coverage describe reading behavior only. They do not measure absorption, understanding, memory, or mastery. Existing data migrates locally and safely.

## 中文

2.1 新增精细阅读轨迹：可选填写本次阅读的起止位置、查看当前进度，并手填实际阅读字符数；字符数留空时会生成明确标记为“估算”的数值。新增统计包括累计阅读字符、估算不同字符、重复阅读量、等效通读遍数、每千字用时、读到末尾的笔记，以及每条记录的字符来源。

默认首页正式命名为“学习总览”，紧凑图表的横轴日期改为易读的月/日格式并下移显示。

位置和覆盖度只描述阅读行为，不代表吸收、理解、记忆或掌握。旧数据会在本地安全迁移。
